verdict.rationale: Slack ships Slackbot as a personal AI agent that takes natural-language requests: it creates project briefs, analyzes reports, updates deals 'just by asking', handles open-ended questions, and routes requests to agents. Its official MCP server also lets AI clients perform Slack actions from natural-language prompts, including searching, sending and drafting messages, creating canvases, and managing lists. missing for 10: documentation of how far natural-language control reaches across core Slack operations (e.g., channel/settings management via Slackbot), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing.
